name: Masonic Temple
science_question: These rocks belong to the same Bright Angel formation, but they are redder and the abraded target Malgosa Crest showed no organic-carbon signal. What makes this side of the valley different?
tasks: Photograph the outcrop and compare its colour with the light-toned rock at Bright Angel.
Find a poorly sorted conglomerate with rounded to subangular clasts and image it with a scale bar.
Find the Malgosa Crest abrasion patch and photograph it.
